Intel: Java package declaration emitted as Module so callers can build FQNs (#112)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"java\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("package com.example.widget;\n\npublic class Widget {\n    public String name() { return \"w\"; }\n}\n", config)
    println(result.language)
    println(result.structure)
    println(result.structure.first().kind)
    println(result.metrics.errorCount)
}
```
